title: 의안의 비용추계 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods of Estimating Costs, etc.)
(1) Cost estimates shall cover costs arising on a mandatory or discretionary basis under the provisions of a bill and costs arising from delegation to subordinate statutes or regulations.
(2) Increases and decreases in fiscal expenditure or fiscal revenue resulting from implementation of a bill shall not be offset against each other, but shall each be indicated separately in the cost estimate.
(3) Where costs are already being incurred under statutes, budgets or fund management plans, the estimate shall cover the remaining costs after deducting existing costs from the total costs required under the bill.
(4) The cost-estimation period shall be five years from the date the relevant bill enters into force, or the shorter period during which fiscal resources are required if that period is less than five years: Provided, That the estimation period may be extended where the trend in costs cannot readily be determined over five years.
(5) A cost estimate shall express quantitatively costs that will be determined or can reasonably be forecast in the future: Provided, That where quantitative presentation is impracticable, the expected results in terms of costs may be described instead.
(6) Matters necessary for methods of estimating costs, including the presentation of estimated amounts, shall be prescribed by regulations issued by the Speaker of the National Assembly.
